items.title: Daryl Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 11, 2024
items.q: There was a plaque that was engraved that Cole Porter lived in The Waldorf Towers

ctx.x: But at The Waldorf I would have a big mixture, a lot of Europeans at the time I was there The Waldorf had a deal with Cunard and at the time it was — I guess it was the Queen Elizabeth was docking and most of them stayed at The Waldorf. That was really helpful to me because once I started performing more in England it was really a nice way to see them and have them help me to fill the audience. But from all countries, and local New Yorkers coming in and knowing, well and even visitors. There was a plaque that was…
He’s decomposing. Okay I want to take you back a bit and I’m going to do that by seeing if you can name this tune. All right? I’ll give it my best rendition. [scats]
